title: Budget Tracker Web Application
description: Built and deployed a user-friendly app to track expenses. Features include transaction categorization, spending summaries, and charts to visualize financial data, helping users stay on top of their budget.

title: Course Review Analysis: End-to-End Application
description: This project delivered a platform for analyzing and visualizing course feedback using BERT, a transformer-based sentiment analysis model, along with dynamic visualizations and an intuitive web interface.

title: Search Engine
description: Built a domain-based search engine with seed page as KU official page and the web crawler crawls all the pages starting from seed page and stores the data. Users can search queries related to the domain of the search engine and get the relevant search results.

title: Portfolio Website
description: This project is my personal portfolio website designed to showcase my skills, projects, and accomplishments. Built with HTML, CSS, and React, it features a modern, responsive design optimized for both desktop and mobile devices.

title: Graduate Admissions Prediction
description: By analyzing a large dataset containing GRE, TOEFL scores, GPA, and other features, this project predicts the candidate's admission chances using machine learning techniques.

title: Multi-modal GenAI Chatbot (In Progress)
description: This project is focused on integrating large language models and multimodal AI capabilities, aiming to support AI responses based on multiple input types.
